cards.mood: The piece opens with an atmospheric, almost mystical tension that abruptly shifts into a high-energy, aggressive assault.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars serve as the core harmonic and melodic drivers, present from the first heavy riff to the final chord.
